character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A cute, small, magical nine-tailed fox companion in charming 2D pixel art. She has soft cream-colored fur with warm golden-orange accents, large fluffy pointed ears with coral-pink inner fur, big expressive dark amber eyes, rosy cheeks, and a tiny heart-shaped nose. Her most distinctive feature is her nine fluffy tails, fanning out behind her like a soft golden-orange sunburst with pale cream tips. Her body is small and rounded, with tiny paws and a fluffy chest. She wears a little teal ribbon with a pink heart charm around her neck. Her expression is gentle, curious, affectionate, and slightly mischievous. Cozy magical creature aesthetic, clean pixel clusters, crisp dark outlines, limited warm pastel color palette, consistent proportions, readable silhouette, simple shading, transparent background. Full-body character, facing slightly toward the viewer, sitting in a relaxed pose. Designed as a tiny virtual pet for a handheld AI companion, recognizable at 32×32 to 64×64 pixels. Original character design, not a direct copy of any existing Pokémon.
